list: Stone lamp set dividing work and rest spaces, combining classic form with modern design. However, tired Tianshis would rather bend down and go through the hole than go around it, much to the chagrin of the designer.

Smart display rack that automatically stores and displays blueprints. Tianshis use it to keep their most valuable knowledge—concepts taking place in reality, be it highly productive fields, or cities that can conquer the barrens.
Simple wall lamp at the Tianshi institute. The nickname comes from how you can remove it from the wall and use it as portable lighting at night.

File cabinet filled with meeting minutes, interdepartmental communications, and HR files. Most Tianshi stay as far from it as possible. 'Ahem. This is the territory of the institute's administrative and logistics departments. Do not enter.'

Large dougong lamp made up of many smaller lamps. The dilemma between the efficiency of illumination and ease of maintenance is a controversial topic amongst the Tianshis, but so far the lights have stayed on.

Cushioned bench with a low back. The Tianshis like to pair them together to form a makeshift bed. Technical hurdles do not go away with a good night's sleep, but the headaches and muscle pain from pulling all-nighters do.

The Exploration 2.0 terminal reduces the time Tianshis need to peruse the archives, as well as the risk of being buried in paper. 'The T9 keyboard UI is for the older generation. You need a Tianshi apparatus to really make the most of it.'
Standard interior wall of a Tianshi institute, with an anti-Originium layer to protect against hazardous environments. The pride of the Tumu Tianshis when they argue with Nongye Tianshis.

Standard institute floor, similar specs as the walls. When they get tired of the Tumu Tianshis' blabbering, the Nongye Tianshis stomp on the floor to remind them who grew the food they ate before the new Dahuang plates were even imagined.
The mountains and rivers are brilliant; a deity leaves no traces.
theme: An accurate reconstruction of the Dahuang Tianshi Institute. Like the first handful of fertile soil Shennong cultivated for the entire land, the Tianshi's ideals grow, sprout, and are harvested here.

list:
You have tread the earth of Dahuang.
Roll up your sleeves and pants, step into the muddy water, and tend to the seedlings.
During Here A People Sows, obtain Operator Wanqing.

You befriended a young kite-flying Tianshi.
He steps out of Dahuang with an ancient ideal in his heart.
During Here A People Sows, spend 2400 Sky Poles in [Shennong Market].

After listening to the opera, you couldn't help but buy some Dahuang specialties at the temple fair.
The Shennong Temple Fair sells things from all over Yan, just like the people here, who have come from the four corners of the land.
Complete all stages in [Agricultural Plate] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

You protected Dahuang's harvest for the year.
The people of Dahuang will not take a single step back, even for but a single grain.
Complete all [Commissions from the Tianshi Bureau] and claim rewards.

You solve the Tianshi Bureau's age-old mysteries.
Without even realizing it, you have helped many an apprentice solve the problems given to them by their teachers.
Complete HS-6 with a 3-star rating and at least 2 unpolluted Farmland.

You saved some experimental crops from the Blight.
The Tianshis' and farmers' hard work has not gone to waste.
Complete HS-7 with a 3-star rating and at least 1 Miasma not having absorbed any pollution.

You stop the pollution at its source with astute foresight.
While no fin can survive in water that is too clear, people will go hungry if the rice is lost.
Complete all stages in [City Core] on Challenge Mode.

You read the Chronicles of Shennong and learned about her life.
It sure is vivid and detailed for an account said to be written a hundred years after her death...
Complete all stages in [Far Side of the Great River] on Challenge Mode (excluding HS-MO-1).

You touched the Sui Regulator's stamp as you flipped open the final page of the copy of Shennong's surviving manuscript.
Her life in the north was not a lonely one. Her friends have survived, and her dreams have flourished.
Complete HS-9 with a 3-star rating and no more than 4 polluted Farmland.

The Ministry of Revenue bequeathed this shiny medal to recognize your success in tackling a century-long production problem.
'One soul lives and withers, but the myriad grains last forever.'
set: Here A People Sows Engraved Medal Set

Engraved medal set that commemorates the efforts of the people of Dahuang to protect their crops.
Good farmland is hard to come by in the harsh north. Every grain is blood, sweat, and tears.
Here, they will reap what they have sowed.
